CustomField.description: Brief field 19. Required from stage 8. The brief gives no rule: we assume monthly cohorts, and the client joins the cohort of the month after the prepayment (YYYY-MM). A formula, so it never drifts and needs no list of months (brief review 7).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The cohort the client starts in: the month after the prepayment. Filled automatically.
CustomField.label: Start period
